items.followUp: Define magnification and resolving power of a microscope.

rubric.why: Shows that magnification compares the image size with the actual object size.
rubric.description: Defines magnification as the ratio of image size to actual size, or how many times larger the image is than the actual object.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct comparison or ratio of image size to actual object size.

rubric.why: States that resolving power concerns distinguishing nearby points as separate.
rubric.description: Defines resolving power as the ability to distinguish two very close points as separate.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that close points or objects can be distinguished as separate.

modelAnswer: Magnification is the number of times an image is larger than the actual object, or the ratio of image size to actual size.
Resolving power is the ability to distinguish two very close points as separate.
